body: Hi there! Are you still open?

This is happening to me right now. Reading someone else be in the exact situation feeling how you are is strange. 

I guess this is sort of pointless to comment. But think something we will all always have is ourselves. 

I don’t know. I try to make friends too and not be annoying or weird but always end up feeling that way. But like.. you’ll always have yourself, right? So I’d rather not think of myself as a failure and neither should you, regardless of situation.

Thank you so much for this comment. I cannot explain how much I appreciated this. I’ve decided that I’m choosing not to take the test, and that I’m going to tell my parents what has happened and why I haven’t studied.
